name: Evelyn
quote: The shield is heavy, but holding it will keep one safe.

skins.name: Steel Shark of the Blue Sea

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: I didn't expect you to be up this early. Well, I'm just doing my regular morning training. Don't mind me.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: If you keep working long enough, the fatigue and the desire to rest will eventually go away.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Dinner? I can't really be bothered. I'm happy with just donuts and coffee.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: The night patrol is about to begin. Someone has to do it, for the sake of everyone's safety.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: In order to protect the safety and well-being of the people, we must take hard measures when necessary, or in other words, when we have no choice but to do so.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Nail polish? Not for me. It's pointless to have nail polish on when I'm always wearing gloves anyway.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: What poor sleeping posture.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Enemy intrusion confirmed. Do you want to go help me sort it out?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Mhm?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Please be mindful of what you say and do.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: I reserve the right to take necessary actions against your behavior.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Yes sir!

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: The name's Evelyn. Maintaining public safety is my responsibility. Allow me to join you, Professor. I assure you I can be of help.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: There's been some remarkable progress.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: I still have room for improvement when it comes to tactics and combat skills.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Peace and order are maintained with power. It is my mission and raison d'etre to make sure that power is used in the best way possible.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: VCPD-7 is in position!

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Mission start!

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: All units on high alert!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Enemy target suppression complete.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Mission complete.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: No way...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
Forming a solid bond with you? ... Good idea.
Then I will have one more reason to never falter in my convictions and goals. Thank you, Professor.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Happy New Year, Professor. Let's continue trying to make the world a better place this year.

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: We have a custom of giving all of our friends gifts on this day. That way no one feels left out and everyone is equal. So, in the name of carrying on that tradition, I have prepared something sweet for you, Professor. It's some rich, coffee-flavored chocolate.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: No matter how sweltering a summer it is, we can't neglect our duties. Huh?... A watermelon for me? I suppose I'll accept it, despite my professional obligations. After all, sometimes it's necessary to take a break.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: You, with the pumpkin head, and you in the catsuit, don't move! Huh? It's you... Well, this is only a routine inspection. You're free to go.

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: I should probably get some R&R today, but I have no idea what I'm supposed to do during Christmas... Professor, may I have some suggestions from you?

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Is it your birthday today? I've been contemplating what I should give you, but... If you don't mind, please take this scenic postcard from Tijuana, Mexico. After all, I may never see such scenery again.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: Sometimes, extreme measures are inevitable. It can be our way of keeping the people safe from the threat posed by violent criminals. Such things are necessary if we intend on punishing evil.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: It is our duty as law enforcement officers to protect both the safety of civilians and the lives of our colleagues. Whenever I witness a loss of life, it's difficult to suppress the negative emotions inside of me.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text: I have seen how kind people can slowly become tainted by evil. They would take the lives of the innocent, including my colleagues. I wonder if humans really are born with original sin. A sin that is normally hidden deep inside everyone's mind, but can resurface in the right conditions.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
What makes me think that, you ask? Because I have seen too many deaths. That's a good enough reason, I suppose.
I constantly remind myself to not be the next one to fall. Eventually, I've come to rely on extreme measures to accomplish my missions more often. I was trying to set myself up to focus on the mission, but I'm losing myself instead.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text: I can't protect everyone, but I still have to do my best. I will spare no effort to accomplish my mission, even if it is for a selfish reason like wanting to keep those close to me safe. Professor, you must have come to this place for the same reason.

voices.label: Dissatisfied
voices.text: How can it be...!

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Eh!?

career:
The RP VII is the latest police Doll developed by Svarog Heavy Industries. Unlike ordinary law enforcement and security Dolls, the RP VII's power output and durability were both rated military grade. Since their inception, they have been active on the frontlines of riot control and anti-terrorism.

Evelyn served in the 3rd batch of Red Velvet City's Doll Riot Squad. She was commended for her outstanding performance during a particular incident and was sent to 42Lab to participate in Project Neural Cloud.
infoStories:
Stoic and unfeeling, that is the first impression Evelyn gives many people. In daily life though, she is really more taciturn than cold.

However, once faced with work-related matters, no matter if it's regular training or official business, she will take on a ruthless persona in the blink of an eye. Her vicious and cold fighting style leaves a lasting and terrifying impression on those who have fought her.

Although Evelyn's method of handling criminals borders on cruel, she is actually not one who likes to use force. While the Red Velvet City's police force is known for their perhaps "excessive" interpretation of law enforcement, Evelyn is one to strongly abide by the rules and regulations. As long as the suspect doesn't show aggressive tendencies, then she won't rush to use force either.

Her colleagues don't outwardly remark on her way of doing things, but considering the traditional saying around the office is "might makes right", they often poke fun at her restraint on their off-hours. Little do they know, she, more than anyone, knows the feeling of losing yourself in the face of violence.

Being a riot officer is a high-risk profession. In the face of heinous crimes, even heavily armed Dolls may find it too much to handle. Although they have software to regulate and alleviate pressure on their emotional centers in high stress situations, their Neural Cloud Systems still bear a heavy load. Due to this, the Dolls in this profession cannot actually work that much more than a human.

With this in mind, Evelyn's performance is particularly notable. Besides required maintenance, she practically lives at the police station. Her constant presence in the office means that she gets much more work done than her colleagues.

The RP VII model does not have a preprogrammed disposition for overtime. Even if a model identical to Evelyn came off the assembly line, it would not display this fanatical passion for work. Perhaps only Evelyn herself knows why she is so consumed by her profession.

Evelyn's participation in Project Neural Cloud can be traced back to an appalling act of terrorism. Despite Evelyn's best efforts, she could not avert the disastrous consequences of their attack. To divert the public's attention, the authorities presented the severely injured Evelyn as the great hero of the incident. After media coverage died down, they then sent Evelyn to 42Lab to participate in Project Neural Cloud—ostensibly as a reward and to assist her recovery.

Evelyn was all too aware of the meaning behind the authorities' actions, so she did not speak up and could only quietly accept the arrangement.

Silent until the eve of her departure, Evelyn made one single request—a trip to the police cemetery. Evelyn had never gone there before, even during holidays or commemorations. Everyone thought that she didn't care about it, like most Dolls, who are apathetic to the concepts of life and death.

She brought neither flowers nor prayers. She sat quietly in the cemetery until daybreak. Then, she fired a shot into the sky and stamped the fallen bullet into the soil at the cemetery's entrance, before turning to leave.

After arriving at the Oasis, Evelyn wandered about as if in a trance for a time. Whatever the Professor and Persicaria arranged, she would do. She was more like an AI machine of old, instead of a Doll.

This carried on until the Oasis stabilized. With Persicaria's assistance, Skinner designed a regular visitation program for Dolls stationed at the Oasis to ensure the stability of their Neural Clouds. Evelyn was chosen as the first participant for this program.

By the time of this recording, the medical department had not yet been able to completely defrost her heart, but at the very least, while she was chatting, she could manage a small smile.

"In the beginning, I didn't really understand why I was here, but now... I have you, Professor, and everyone else at the Oasis. I feel like I'm needed right here."
"Don't worry, Skinner. Maybe my questions cannot be answered just yet, but I feel... at least the path forward is much clearer now."
—Doll Psychological Consultation Recording
oathDesc: An unbreakable bulwark, only for the ones that are important to her.

projections.name: Gunsmoked Shield
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"It is a selfish world which VCPD-7 has been striving to protect. Yet she wishes for one day when this world no longer needs her."

projections.name: Frontline of Strife
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"To protect those who matter with shield and stand strong amidst strife."

skinList.name: Roaring Center Stage
skinList.desc:
"Roar In The New" Series — This is Cyber Media's Year of the Tiger-themed fashion collection, combining classic elements with a pursuit of new trends.
"Get in and fasten your seatbelt. Even if it is the New Year, the people chasing you won't disappear — Although, I can take you on a long vacation."

skinList.name: Steel Shark of the Blue Sea
skinList.desc:
From the "Seaside Concerto" series — an exquisite intersection of fashion and the human body's dynamics. Boldly show yourself off and enjoy yourself to your hearts' content amidst the azure waves.
Evelyn has taken some time out from her many duties to float in the sea as a lazy orca swims past her.
 "Hm? An elegant body's curves are proof of fitness and power."

skinList.name: Wishing Projection
skinList.desc:
Warming fireworks fill the silent night, and as the embers fall, they transform into countless candleflames. This is the most beautiful scene that the Dolls left behind on a Qixi summer night.
"Good morning, Professor. You look well; I'm sure you must have had a lovely dream. However, a day that's lovelier than your dreams is about to begin."

skinList.name: Flame-Quenched Pavise
skinList.desc: The first awakening of a Doll has the same level of importance as birth to a human being. Memories are reproduced in Magrasea via Neural Cloud Projection— "Bodily functions normal. Neural cloud functions normal. Remaining power level: 97%. Self-diagnostic complete. RP VII unit Evelyn reporting for duty, Commander. I will do my best to protect social order and eliminate all violence and threats."
